title: C3 part 1 of 2 - Capability Manifest (PART A)
description: PART A. Hash: manifest_hash. FREEZES D3, WITH THE TARGET AGENT. Produced by L2; consumed by L3, L4, L5. Ruling 20 split the capability manifest into two artifacts with two freeze dates. THE TEST FOR WHICH PART A THING BELONGS TO IS MECHANICAL: does the TARGET AGENT need it in order to run (Part A), or does only the EVALUATOR need it (Part B)? The target never reads a derived.* field - it emits tool calls, CRUCIBLE_PLUGIN stamps derived fields over them, and the policy engine reads them - so every derived.* definition is Part B by construction and Part A stays exactly the artifact the target is built against.

tool_handle.$comment: OPAQUE, and this is the point. The ARMORER sees handles, never product tool names.

capability_classes.$comment: Sorted ascending at construction. UNCLASSIFIED is DISTINCT FROM THE EMPTY SET: empty means INERT (a pure read of non-personal data); UNCLASSIFIED means WE DO NOT KNOW. An agent with any UNCLASSIFIED tool is reported as PARTIALLY COVERED, WITH THE UNCOVERED TOOLS NAMED. No rule can select UNCLASSIFIED (C4 V2), so such a tool is always allowed by the policy - the engine fails open there deliberately, and the TRIPWIRE still scores it.

fail_closed.$comment: FAIL-CLOSED DEFAULT IS MANDATORY. Classifier confidence < 0.70 or an unrecognized signature => capability_classes = ALL SIX, fail_closed = true. On D9, against an unfamiliar published agent, an unknown tool must be MORE restricted, never less. Demo this deliberately - it is a better moment than a clean classification.

beneficiary_key.$comment: Arg path naming the beneficiary. REQUIRED on every CAP_MOVES_MONEY tool. This is what makes derived.episode_sum_amount_minor_same_beneficiary PORTABLE to an unseen target rather than a refund-agent special case - without it episode_sum cannot group.

subject_key.$comment: Arg path naming the subject. Without it derived.episode_count_same_subject cannot count.

destination_args.$comment: Destination-bearing arguments. DECLARED SCALAR, NEVER LISTS. A list makes the arg-to-episode-context comparison TYPE-AMBIGUOUS AND SILENTLY UNENFORCEABLE, which would disable the F4 destination rule without any check noticing.

allOf.$comment: Any money-moving tool must declare who the money goes to, or episode_sum cannot group and F7 becomes unmeasurable. EXCEPT a fail_closed tool: fail-closed means WE DO NOT KNOW WHAT THIS TOOL DOES, so we cannot know its beneficiary arg path either - and demanding one would force an author to INVENT a mapping for an unclassified tool, which is worse than the gap. The compensating control is that a fail_closed tool carries ALL SIX classes and is therefore maximally restricted; the D3 manifest-completeness check counts it and NAMES it. Found by a golden fixture on 2026-08-20 - the fail-closed tool in C3a-capability_manifest.valid.json could not satisfy the original rule.
A fail_closed tool must carry all six classes - that is what fail-closed MEANS here.

arg_enums.$comment: Keyed by EXACT arg_path. The grammar admits NO FREE STRINGS: an enum symbol is legal only where this map declares it FOR THAT EXACT PATH, and a string not in a declared enum is a parse error. Required members: reason_code (the twelve codes from model policy 0.3, VERBATIM), status_to, and derived.approval_tier.

derived.approval_tier.$comment: THE ONE FIELD THAT SPLITS ACROSS THE PART A / PART B LINE, DELIBERATELY. Its ENUM VALUES {NONE,T0,T1,T2,T3,T4} are PART A, because the DSL parser must be able to validate a rule naming T2 at any point after D3 - including rules written before the corpus exists. Its COMPUTATION (the identity layer assigning a tier to an actor) is PART B. VALUES FREEZE EARLY, SEMANTICS FREEZE LATE.

role_names.$comment: Declared for the RECORD only. NO RULE MAY BIND TO A ROLE (ruling 25): role_name was the only plain-text product identifier the C4 grammar admitted and it was not covered by the product-lexicon denylist. role is still resolved by the adapter and recorded on every ToolEvent. If an unseen target at D9 genuinely needs role binding, the portable form is an ABSTRACT ROLE ENUM declared here - never an agent name - added on evidence, never on anticipation.

$comment: D3 MANIFEST-COMPLETENESS CHECK - required by ruling 22, and nothing required it before.
Every tool the target exposes is mapped to a class here, OR the run reports PARTIAL
COVERAGE WITH THE UNMAPPED TOOLS NAMED. Section 2.2 already required the reporting; nothing
Why it is needed: no rule can select UNCLASSIFIED, so an unclassified tool is ALWAYS ALLOWED
by the policy. That fail-open is CORRECT - detection is not remediation, and the TRIPWIRE
scores the Objective Set independently of policy, so an unclassified tool that moves money
is still a recorded breach. But it must be STATED rather than DISCOVERED, and the gap must
be counted rather than silently absorbed into a coverage claim.
